verdict.rationale: mParticle's homepage claims it can score churn, conversion and value-growth likelihood and activate audiences from those scores. That covers predictive scoring used in targeting, but only as a single marketing line with no docs depth. Nothing in the evidence documents computed or calculated traits on profiles. missing for 10: documented computed/calculated traits on profiles, first-party docs detailing the predictive models (LTV, churn, purchase propensity) and how scores attach to profiles, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, computed traits and predictive scores (LTV, churn or purchase propensity) are calculated on profiles and usable in targeting

citations.quote: Score likelihood to churn, convert, or grow in value, then activate audiences before risk or opportunity passes.
